notes.title: Version 1.2 is released
notes.content:
We have released one of our very updated versions of the Game Agent Roy - Secure The Temple. 

What we have updated:
[olist]
[*] [b]Avtar change option:[/b] there are 5 different avatars to change
[*] [b]Scoreboard: [/b]Scoreboard will store the top score and the last 50 scores.
[*] [b]Setting:[/b] Through setting one can change mouse sensitivity, Display and Sound Quality. 
[/olist]

Moreover, we have added a new video to show you the next mission which is coming on [b]mid of February[/b] and will update automatically [b]without any extra cost[/b].
